source_files.privacy: Source files remain outside the versioned skill and must never be committed.

wave_selector_convention.note: For example, item 10 is 问卷三10, 问卷三010, and 问卷三110.

depressive_symptoms.score_rule: sum 20 valid items after reversal; retain missingness unless a preregistered prorating rule is adopted
depressive_symptoms.decision: Recompute from valid raw items. T1/T2 legacy totals reproduce exactly; T3 contains raw-range and legacy-total discrepancies.

nssi.instrument: 18-method adolescent self-harm checklist as administered; NSSI naming is prohibited until exclusion of suicidal intent is source-verified
nssi.score_rule: For each method multiply frequency by severity, then sum the 18 products; also retain occurrence and positive-part outcomes for sensitivity analysis.
nssi.decision: Recompute from valid raw pairs. Values outside the administered ranges become missing only in a derived analysis dataset and remain listed in the private issue register.

interparental_conflict.score_rule: Consistent high-conflict sum across all 18 items
interparental_conflict.decision: Do not analyze legacy conflict composites. The T3 resolution variable mixes waves; recompute the same 18-item high-conflict score at every wave and test longitudinal measurement invariance.

identifiers_and_covariates.id_normalization_candidate: lowercase alphabetic prefix plus integer numeric suffix; never overwrite raw IDs
identifiers_and_covariates.sex_policy: Treat as measured sex, not gender. Derive only after source verification or an explicit cross-wave consensus rule; do not coerce anomalous codes.
identifiers_and_covariates.school_policy: Use anonymized school code only. Nine schools are insufficient for routine cluster-robust inference; prefer school fixed effects or a sensitivity analysis.

unresolved_blockers: Verify the eleven normalized T1-T3 ID disagreements against the source linkage record.
Approve the proposed T1-only rule for 13 missing T1 sex codes and 41 cross-wave inconsistencies before multi-group analysis.
Recover exact wave dates or intervals from administration records.
Verify from the instrument source that the self-harm items explicitly exclude suicidal intent before using the NSSI label.
Locate original SPSS scoring syntax if available; it is corroborating evidence, not a substitute for raw-item reconstruction.
